h1: The 7 Best Kids TV Stands for Bedrooms and Playrooms in 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Kids TV Stands 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 7 TV stands for a kid's room or playroom, scored on tip safety, toy storage, TV size limits, outlets and price from $30 to $200.
summary: The SONGMICS BELLAH dresser is the kids TV stand to buy if you want one piece to hold the TV, the clothes and the toys, with an anti-tip kit, five drawers and a charging station. The WLIVE 8-drawer unit is the storage-heavy alternative, the JARHETUN is the budget LED pick, and the AX WABER floor stand frees the most floor space.
intro: A TV stand for a child's room has a different job than one for a living room. It is a toy bin, a dresser and a place for a game console, and it sits where a climbing toddler or a roughhousing eight-year-old will lean on it. So the question to ask is not how many inches of TV it holds. It is whether it stays upright when pulled, and whether the drawers are the kind a kid can open and close without trapping fingers.

This ranking sorts seven stands by tip safety, storage and fit for a bedroom or playroom. Each stand was judged on paper: stated TV size limits, top weight ratings, drawer count, power outlets and anti-tip hardware. Where a listing names no safety hardware, we say so, and every stand here should be anchored to the wall.

products.name: SONGMICS Dresser with App-Controlled LED Lights, 5 Fabric Drawers Dresser | Chest of Drawers with Open Shelf & Charging Station, TV Stand for Bedroom, Cloud White, BELLAH Collection ULGS723WH05S
products.verdict: The only stand here with a stated anti-tip kit plus a USB-C charging station.
products.description:
The BELLAH is a dresser that doubles as a TV stand, measuring 38.9 x 26.8 x 11.8 inches. It combines a steel frame, an engineered wood particleboard top and MDF-reinforced fabric drawers, with five drawers, an open shelf, app-controlled LED lights and a charging station of 2 AC outlets, 1 USB-A and 1 USB-C port.

It wins because it lists an anti-tip kit alongside adjustable feet, which is the single most relevant safety feature for a kids room, and the charging station lets a tablet or console charge without a power strip on the floor. Against the WLIVE it gives up three drawers but gains the explicit tip-restraint hardware and a newer USB-C port. The app lighting is a toy for a kid, but it can be turned off.

Buy it for a bedroom where the TV is secondary to the dresser job. One gap: no maximum TV size or top weight rating appears on the listing, so measure your TV against the 38.9 inch width first.
pros: USB-C and AC charging built in
products.idealFor: Parents who want a dresser, TV stand and charging spot in one.
products.skipIf: You need a stated weight rating for a heavy TV.

products.name: WLIVE LED Dresser TV Stand for 55 Inch TV, 8 Fabric Drawers, Black Dresser | Fit TVs up to 55in with 47.17"W Wood Top, Built-in AC Power Outlet and USB-A, Fabric Dresser for Bedroom Storage Living Room
products.verdict: Eight drawers in two sizes and a 66 lb top rating make it the best toy and clothes organizer.
products.description:
The WLIVE measures 47.17 x 26.38 x 11.73 inches and holds up to a 55 inch TV on a wood top rated to 66 lb. It has eight removable fabric drawers in two sizes, a steel frame with cross rods, steel slide tracks, five adjustable steel feet, and a power strip with 2 AC outlets and 2 USB-A ports on a 5 ft cord.

It ranks second because it has the most storage and a clearly stated weight rating, which neither the SONGMICS nor the JARHETUN gives. The tradeoff is safety documentation: the listing says the unit stays stable and does not tip, but it names no anti-tip strap or wall anchor. For a kids room, that missing hardware is why it sits under the SONGMICS. The USB ports are only 2.4A, not USB-C.

It is the pick for a shared bedroom or playroom where sheer drawer count matters. The caveat: the fabric drawers hold light to medium loads, so do not use them for books or heavy gear.
products.idealFor: Shared rooms where toys, clothes and gear all need a home.

products.name: JARHETUN TV Stand with LED Lights, Entertainment Center with Open Shelves and Fabric Drawer, Media Console for 55 Inch TV, Television Stands for Living Room, Bedroom, Black
products.verdict: A low, wide console with an anti-tip device and an LED strip for $30 to $50.
products.description:
The JARHETUN is a 46.1 x 11.4 x 19 inch console for TVs up to 55 inches, with two open shelves, one fabric drawer, an LED strip in 22 colors and 22 modes, a metal frame under a particleboard top, adjustable feet and an anti-tip device. It is sold for living rooms, bedrooms, nurseries and hallways.

Its rank is high because it keeps the one safety item that matters in a kids room, an anti-tip device, at a price in the $30 to $50 range. A 19 inch height also means a short child cannot be hit by a toppling TV from above. It sits under the WLIVE because one fabric drawer and two open shelves hold far less than eight drawers, and open shelves invite clutter at kid height.

Choose it for a small bedroom where the TV sits on top and a console sits underneath. The caveat is the thin storage: toys will need a separate bin, and the LED controls are an app or button kids will fiddle with.
products.idealFor: Small bedrooms where a low, wide, safe console is enough.
products.skipIf: You need serious toy or clothes storage.

products.name: DUMOS TV Stand with Drawers, Small TV Stand Dresser for Bedroom, Grey | 5 Foldable Fabric Drawers, Open Shelf for DVD Player and Soundbar, Adjustable Feet, for Small Apartment, Dorm and Guest Room
products.verdict: A compact 38 inch dresser-stand with five drawers for TVs up to 45 inches.
products.description:
The DUMOS is a small unit, 38 inches wide and 11.8 inches deep, with five foldable fabric drawers and an open middle shelf sized for a soundbar or console. A powder-coated metal frame with reinforced crossbars and four adjustable feet keeps it steady, and the stated TV limit is 45 inches. The back is open for cable routing.

It ranks fourth because the size is right for a child's room but the safety detail is thinner. It beats the Furologee on drawer storage, yet it lists no anti-tip kit, and the 45 inch cap matters: a typical 50 inch TV simply does not fit. Compared with the JARHETUN, it holds more but stands taller at about 31.5 inches, so a falling TV has more distance to travel.

Buy it for a dorm-sized or guest room with a modest TV. Assembly is listed at 20 to 30 minutes with an installation video, and the drawers suit remotes, controllers and light clothing, not heavy items.

products.name: AX WABER Floor TV Stand with Mount for 26-60 inch TVs up to 77 lbs, Height Adjustable Swivel Tilt,Tall Standing TV Stand with Wood Base, Saving Space Design for Bedroom, Living Room and Corner, White
products.verdict: A pole-style floor stand that lifts the TV off furniture and swivels toward the bed.
products.description:
The AX WABER is a steel floor stand with a wood base and a built-in mount, for 26 to 60 inch TVs up to 77 lb, with VESA patterns from 100 x 100 mm to 400 x 400 mm. It has three height positions, a swivel of 30 degrees either way and a tilt from plus 10 to minus 5 degrees, and it needs no wall drilling.

It ranks fifth because it solves a different problem. There is no shelf, so it stores nothing, but it clears the whole floor under the TV, which is useful in a small bedroom or a corner. The wood base adds anti-slip pads, yet a tall pole with a TV on top is still a tipping risk if a child hangs from it, which is the reason it sits below the low furniture-style stands.

Buy it for a teen's room or a corner where the TV needs to angle toward a bed. The caveat is that a toddler can reach the base and swing the screen, so for small children choose a low unit with an anti-tip device.

products.name: Furologee TV Stand, Entertainment Center with Open Shelves, Rustic Brown | TV Table with Storage Shelves, 4 Hooks, TV Console Up for 55 Inch TVs, TV Stands for Living Room, Bedroom
products.verdict: Open mesh shelves and hooks give airflow and display room, but nothing is closed off.
products.description:
The Furologee is an open-frame console of about 46.7 x 21.8 x 11.8 inches in a rustic brown, with two tiers of open mesh shelves, four hooks, a particleboard top and a metal frame. It is sold for TVs up to 55 inches and promotes the open design as good for airflow around consoles.

It ranks sixth because everything is visible, and a kid's room is where small parts and cables get pulled. The open mesh shelves and hooks suit display and a gaming setup more than concealment. Against the JARHETUN, the same price range buys you no drawer at all and no listed anti-tip device. The metal frame and wood grain top are a good look for an older child's room.

Choose it for a teen or tween room where the console is shelved neatly and nothing needs to be hidden. The caveat is plain: no drawer, no safety hardware, and no stated top weight rating on the listing.
products.idealFor: Tween and teen rooms with a tidy console setup.
products.skipIf: You want closed storage for toys.

products.name: Clikuutory Modern Lighting 51 inch TV Stand with Large Storage Drawer for 32 40 50 55 Inch TVs, TV Console with 20 Color LED Lights, Entertainment Center Media and Open Shelf for Bedroom, Pink
products.verdict: A pink 51 inch console with a big center drawer, but glass parts and a $100 to $200 price.
products.description:
The Clikuutory is a 51 x 14 x 18 inch console in pink, with 20 LED colors and four modes controlled by remote or phone, a center drawer measuring 26.18 x 12.4 x 8.27 inches, and a glass divider. It uses laminated MDF and tempered glass, and the listing claims a bearing capacity of 220 pounds for TVs up to 55 inches.

It ranks last because tempered glass and a child's room are an awkward match, even though tempered glass breaks into small pieces rather than shards. Against the JARHETUN it costs several times as much, in the $100 to $200 bracket, and neither lists strong tip-restraint detail. The big drawer is a genuine plus for games and remotes, and the low 18 inch height is safe for the TV.

Buy it if style matters most, for example a girl's room built around the color pink. Anchor it, keep the glass out of reach of throwing toys, and note that the listing gives no anti-tip hardware.

methodology.title: Tip safety
methodology.description: We looked for listed anti-tip kits, adjustable feet, steel frames and low profiles, since falling furniture is the main hazard in a kids room.

methodology.title: Toy and clothes storage
methodology.description: Drawer count, drawer size and open versus closed storage were compared against a child's actual clutter.

methodology.title: TV size and weight rating
methodology.description: Stated TV size limits and top weight ratings were checked against modern screen sizes.

methodology.title: Power and cable handling
methodology.description: Built-in outlets, USB ports and cable routing were weighed, since loose cords are another risk for small children.

methodology.title: Materials and price
methodology.description: Metal frames, glass parts, surface materials and price bracket were scored against what a family realistically pays.

whatMatters.detail: A tip-restraint strap or bracket fixes the unit to the wall so it cannot topple when a child climbs or pulls a drawer. It matters more in a kid's room than any style choice. Look for an anti-tip kit on the listing, as with the SONGMICS and JARHETUN, and install it even when the stand seems stable.

A stand lists the largest TV it accepts and sometimes a weight limit for the top. The DUMOS stops at 45 inches, while the WLIVE rates its top at 66 lb for 55 inch sets. Check both numbers against your TV's width and weight before buying, since the screen width must not overhang the top.

Fabric drawers on a metal track are light, soft-edged and cheap, and they fold flat. They also sag under books or hard toys, and a determined kid can tear them. Treat them as soft storage for clothes and stuffed toys, and check the listing for the weight limit per drawer.

A low console, such as the 19 inch JARHETUN or the 18 inch Clikuutory, keeps the screen near eye level for a seated child and reduces the drop if something falls. A taller unit puts a heavy TV higher. Check overall height on the listing and compare it to your child's reach.

A stand with AC and USB outlets, like the WLIVE or SONGMICS, removes the power strip from the floor where small hands find it. It also gives the tablet a charging spot. Look for UL or ETL certification on the outlet strip, and for a cord long enough to reach the wall.

faq.q: Will these fit a 55 inch TV?
faq.a: The WLIVE, JARHETUN, Furologee and Clikuutory list 55 inches, while the DUMOS stops at 45. The AX WABER mounts up to 60. Measure your TV's width, since the screen needs to stay inside the top.

faq.q: What is the biggest mistake with a kid's TV stand?
faq.a: Skipping the wall anchor. Even a stable stand like the SONGMICS or JARHETUN can tip if a child climbs the drawers or hangs on the unit. Use the supplied anti-tip kit and screw it into a stud.

faq.q: Is the SONGMICS worth it over the WLIVE?
faq.a: For a kids room, yes. The SONGMICS lists an anti-tip kit and a USB-C port, while the WLIVE adds three drawers and a stated 66 lb top rating. Pick the WLIVE only if storage outweighs listed safety hardware.

Plan 20 to 30 minutes for the DUMOS, and longer for the eight-drawer WLIVE. All list included tools and instructions. Level the adjustable feet on the finished unit and fasten the anti-tip hardware before placing the TV.

faq.q: How do I look after fabric drawers?
faq.a: Keep loads light and avoid sitting on them. Wipe fabric with a damp cloth, and keep the tracks clear of crumbs and small toys. On the DUMOS, the drawers fold flat when you take them out.

faq.q: Can a child use the LED lights safely?
faq.a: Yes, but they are a distraction. The JARHETUN, SONGMICS and Clikuutory all control lights by app, remote or button. Turn the strip off at bedtime and set a lock on the app if your kid keeps changing it.

finalTake: For most children's rooms, buy the SONGMICS BELLAH: it has an anti-tip kit, five drawers and a charging station in one piece. The WLIVE is better if toys and clothes are the real problem, and the JARHETUN is the sensible budget choice with a low profile. Teens can take the AX WABER if floor space is short. Whatever you buy, bolt it to the wall.
